best_ability.name: Djinn's Mark
best_ability.scaling: 65 base damage · ×0.3 per Spirit Power — honest note: Mirage's scaling is weak everywhere; this is a mark-SPAM build
best_ability.why: Straight talk: Mirage is a gun carry and his spirit scaling is poor (best is the mark's ×0.3). The NUKE doesn't pretend otherwise — it supercharges mark uptime with cooldown and charge items so detonations, slows and Traveler plays chain nonstop. The gun still kills; the mark decides when.

swaps.why: Cleanse Threadsap stacks before she steals the Spirit Power this whole build runs on.

Healing cut beats max-HP shred when they out-sustain the burst.

nuke.kit_synergy: Every imbue goes on Djinn's Mark — a cooldown build wearing a nuke's coat, and the label says so. Charge and cooldown items keep a mark on every target, every fight, while your gun does gun things to marked targets.

Dust Devil becomes engage cover instead of an escape.
